The Strangler Fig Pattern

The strangler fig pattern incrementally replaces a legacy system by routing functionality to new services until the old system can be retired safely.

How it works

A facade intercepts requests and routes them either to the legacy system or to new services. Over time the new implementation grows and the legacy system shrinks, like a strangler fig around a host tree.

Martin Fowler described this approach for incremental legacy modernization.
